rigConvention: Hips root; torso/head extend +Y; all upper/lower limb segments extend -Y. Local block rig, not original Mixamo local axes. Rotations are derived from actual uploaded Mixamo segment directions. Body/head axial twists are omitted; root yaw/tilt retained. Bone lengths/anchors are target-rig choices.

walk.rootMotionSpace: Relative to first source hips frame, in metres; first XYZ is zero. Position in bed/room separately.
walk.rootHeadingBasis: Root +Z axis projected XZ: upright face direction.
